title: Exposition on Psalm 21
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Expositions on the Psalms (Augustine) > Psalm 21

paragraphs.text: To the end, a psalm of David himself.
1. The title is a familiar one; the Psalm is of Christ.

2. <quote>O Lord, the King shall rejoice in Your strength</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:1}} . O Lord, in Your strength, whereby the Word was made flesh, the Man Christ Jesus shall rejoice. <quote>And shall exult exceedingly in Your salvation.</quote> And in that, whereby Thou quickenest all things, shall exult exceedingly.

3. <quote>You have given Him the desire of His soul</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:2}} . He desired to eat the Passover, {{BIBLE:luk 22:15}} and to lay down His life when He would, and again when He would to take it; and You have given it to Him. {{BIBLE:joh 10:18}} <quote>And hast not deprived Him of the good pleasure of His lips.</quote> <quote>My peace,</quote> says He, <quote>I leave with you:</quote> {{BIBLE:joh 14:27}} and it was done.

4. For You have presented Him with the blessings of sweetness {{BIBLE:psa 20:3}} . Because He had first quaffed the blessing of Your sweetness, the gall of our sins did not hurt Him. Diapsalma. You have set a crown of precious stone on His Head. At the beginning of His discoursing precious stones were brought, and compassed Him about; His disciples, from whom the commencement of His preaching should be made.

5. <quote>He asked life; and You gave Him:</quote> He asked a resurrection, saying, <quote>Father, glorify Your Son;</quote> {{BIBLE:joh 17:1}} and You gave it Him, <quote>Length of days for ever and ever</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:4}} . The prolonged ages of this world which the Church was to have, and after them an eternity, world without end.

6. <quote>His glory is great in Your salvation</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:5}} . Great indeed is His glory in the salvation, whereby You have raised Him up again. <quote>Glory and great honour shall Thou lay upon Him.</quote> But You shall yet add unto Him glory and great honour, when You shall place Him in heaven at Your right hand.

7. <quote>For You shall give Him blessing for ever and ever.</quote> This is the blessing which You shall give Him for ever and ever: <quote>You shall make Him glad in joy together with Your countenance</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:6}} . According to His manhood, You shall make Him glad together with Your countenance, which He lifted up to You.

8. <quote>For the King hopes in the Lord.</quote> For the King is not proud, but humble in heart, he hopes in the Lord. <quote>And in the mercy of the Most Highest He shall not be moved</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:7}} . And in the mercy of the Most Highest His obedience even unto the death of the Cross shall not disturb His humility.

9. <quote>Let Your hand be found by all Your enemies.</quote> Be Your power, O King, when You come to judgment, found by all Your enemies; who in Your humiliation discerned it not. <quote>Let Your right hand find out all that hate You</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:8}} . Let the glory, wherein Thou reign at the right hand of the Father, find out for punishment in the day of judgment all that hate You; for that now they have not found it.

10. <quote>You shall make them like a fiery oven:</quote> You shall make them on fire within, by the consciousness of their ungodliness: <quote>In the time of Your countenance:</quote> in the time of Your manifestation. <quote>The Lord shall trouble them in His wrath, and the fire shall devour them</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:9}} . And then, being troubled by the vengeance of the Lord, after the accusation of their conscience, they shall be given up to eternal fire, to be devoured.

11. <quote>Their fruit shall You destroy out of the earth.</quote> Their fruit, because it is earthly, shall You destroy out of the earth. <quote>And their seed from the sons of men</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:10}} . And their works; or, whomsoever they have seduced, You shall not reckon among the sons of men, whom You have called into the everlasting inheritance.

12. <quote>Because they turned evils against You.</quote> Now this punishment shall be recompensed to them, because the evils which they supposed to hang over them by Your reign, they turned against You to Your death. <quote>They imagined a device, which they were not able to establish</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:11}} . They imagined a device, saying, <quote>It is expedient that one die for all:</quote> {{BIBLE:joh 11:50}} which they were not able to establish, not knowing what they said.

13. <quote>For You shall set them low.</quote> For You shall rank them among those from whom in degradation and contempt You will turn away. <quote>In Your leavings You shall make ready their countenance</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:12}} . And in these things that Thou leavest, that is, in the desires of an earthly kingdom, You shall make ready their shamelessness for Your passion.

14. <quote>Be Thou exalted, O Lord, in Your strength</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 20:13}} . Be Thou, Lord, whom in humiliation they did not discern, exalted in Your strength, which they thought weakness. <quote>We will sing and praise Your power.</quote> In heart and in deed we will celebrate and make known Your marvels.
